items.title: Treasure Island
items.overview: Alliances fracture as the voyage wears on. Bess and Graham play a cat-and-mouse game, while Long John targets Jim; when Graham makes his move, the truth surfaces. The consequences are deadly and Jim is forced to take control of his fate.

items.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
items.overview: Paul and Bob travel to the River Ribble in Lancashire for one last fish with their little canine pal, Ted.The beautiful river Ribble runs through the rolling hills of the Yorkshire Dales, onwards to Lancashire before meeting the Irish Sea in Lytham. With the river in good health, Paul and Bob hope to catch a good chub or a mighty barbel on this stretch of the water, while Ted hopes to taste Bob's Lancashire hotpot.

items.title: The Simpsons
items.overview: Bart and Lisa are trapped in an abandoned immersive theme park experience.

items.title: Ice Airport Alaska
items.overview: A lone bush pilot races to stock ultra-marathon checkpoints, a heli pilot risks a sling-load at 4,000 feet and comes inches from disaster, and a vintage DC-3 plane is a village's only lifeline as a storm closes in.

items.title: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver
items.overview: On Last Week Tonight with John Oliver, John Oliver presents a satirical look at the week in news, politics and current events.

items.title: Heartland
items.overview: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

items.title: Battle Through the Heavens
items.overview: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

items.title: Coronation Street
items.overview: Step onto the cobbles for all the drama, secrets and unforgettable moments from the world's longest running TV soap.

items.title: Drag Race España
items.overview: Drag Race España is searching to find Spain's next drag superstar! Each week the queens will be put to the test in numerous contests and challenges. Follow along to see who will survive the fierce competition and claim the crown!

items.title: Tracker
items.overview: When a woman disappears after helping a terrified teenage runaway, Colter uncovers a disturbing case of abuse and embarks on a desperate search to save them both.

items.title: American Hostage
items.overview: Having sold the lie of immunity on-air and successfully convinced Tony to sign the agreement, Fred now finds himself shut out of law enforcement's plans to bring this crisis to an end today, one way or another.

items.title: Maigret
items.overview: With an injury and his investigation shut down, Maigret and his team continue investigating Adeline's past from his apartment. When they uncover she was only the latest of three violent deaths, Maigret must decide whether to destroy two more lives.

items.title: Emmerdale
items.overview: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

items.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera
items.overview: Some of the most amazing, eye-opening and downright scary paranormal videos from around the world are featured as a panel of experts break down the footage and analyze what exactly the eyewitnesses captured.

items.title: 60 Minutes
items.overview: Destination: Nowhere - As the Trump administration seeks to carry out the largest deportation operation in American history, it is removing more and more people to countries they are not from and often have no ties to. It's called "third country deportation," and a 60 Minutes investigation reveals how some of these third countries are forcing deportees back to the nations they fled, places where U.S. immigration judges have ruled they could not be sent because they'd likely face persecution or torture. 60 Minutes' Gianna Toboni travels to West Africa, where she meets a man who says he was sent, against his will, to his home country, despite a U.S. judge's ruling. She also interviews the top lawyer at the Department of Homeland Security, James Percival, about these kinds of deportations. Andy Court, Annabelle Hanflig, and Camilo Montoya-Galvez are the producers.#FreeTinaPeters - After one of the worst wildfires in Colorado history, Governor Jared Polis (D) asked the Trump administration for federal aid but was denied. The decision came as a top election official, Tina Peters, was serving a prison sentence after being convicted in connection with breaching her county's election system in pursuit of President Trump's claim that rigged voting machines cost him the 2020 election. Governor Polis commuted Peters' sentence in May and saw the release of federal funding into his state. Correspondent Bill Whitaker interviews Governor Polis and Peters in Colorado about the case, conviction and commutation. Sarah Koch is the producer.Australia's Experiment - Last year, Australia became the first country in the world to force many social media companies to prevent children under the age of 16 from having accounts. 60 Minutes' Holly Williams reports from Australia on how the ban is working, why other countries are now following its lead, and what the tech giants stand to lose if the Australian experiment succeeds. Jacqueline Williams and Erin Lyall are the producers.

items.title: Sister Wives
items.episodeTitle: The Pink Elephant in the Room
items.overview: Janelle continues to push outside her comfort zone and attends a line dancing event; Christine and David play a risqué board game to test their compatibility; Meri and Christine meet one-on-one to confront their tumultuous past.

items.title: This City Is Ours
items.overview: Michael and Diana have barely arrived in their Spanish happy town when they are dragged back into the fold to answer questions around Ricardo's death.

items.title: The Great Canadian Baking Show
items.overview: Picnic Week arrives with three bakes that are perfectly portable. The bakers make South African Picnic Bread, Illusion Ants on a Log and Pain Surprise.

items.title: This Week
items.overview: This Week  is hosted by former Clinton White House staffer and current co-anchor of ABC's weekday morning news show "Good Morning America", George Stephanopoulos offers a look at current events with a focus on the politics of the day. Each week's show includes interviews with top newsmakers (including some of the nation's top political leaders) as well as a roundtable discussion, usually featuring journalists from ABC and other news organizations, of the week's happenings. Since 2008, the program has broadcast from a studio at the Newseum in Washington, D.C.

items.title: Marshals
items.overview: When Kayce and Andrea's off-hours fugitive hunt unexpectedly reveals the whereabouts of a notorious bomber who previously slipped through Cal's fingers, the team is pulled into a dangerous pursuit that threatens to open old wounds. Meanwhile, threats against Belle move frighteningly close to home, and Miles finds himself hiding crucial information from Maddie about Cal's cancer.

items.title: Animal Control
items.overview: When Emily's HR review threatens her reinstatement, Frank appoints himself her investigator.

items.title: Meet the Press
items.episodeTitle: Sen. Adam Schiff, Gov. Gretchen Whitmer, Mike Rogers
items.overview: For almost as long as there has been television, there's been Meet the Press. The hourlong Sunday morning public affairs program has featured interviews with countless U.S. and world leaders, and has reviewed, analyzed and discussed the news of the week -- all while looking toward the week ahead.

items.title: Youth
items.overview: While Alex finally starts to feel like she has it all, Sam navigates new insecurities in her marriage.

items.title: Crossroad Springs
items.overview: As the Hamiltons celebrate Thomas's first birthday, Tina anxiously awaits the arrival of her estranged father, hoping he'll finally meet his grandson. Meanwhile, Janet and Eric take the next step in their relationship.

items.title: Halloween Wars
items.episodeTitle: Back from the Dead: The Final Fright
items.overview: Under the watchful eye of host Rossi Morreale, five teams composed of a pumpkin carving expert, cake artist and sugar artist will battle it out as they create Halloween-themed edible displays that will send chills up your spine. In each episode, teams will face two grueling challenges. First, they'll face off in the Small Scare, where they must create a Halloween-themed design in just 45 minutes. One winning team gets an advantage in the big battle - the Spine Chiller. In the end, their creations will be judged by renowned cake decorator Shinmin Li and make-up artist Brian Kinney, and a rotating panel of celebrity guest judges who are legends in the horror genre. One team will be eliminated after each episode. In the end only one team will be declared Halloween Wars Champion, and walk away with a $50,000 grand prize.

items.title: 90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way
items.overview: 90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way will follow couples where the American is giving up everything and moving across the globe to be with the person they love. Racing against a ticking clock, these six Americans face the challenges of relocating internationally, overcoming major culture shocks, winning over soon-to-be foreign in-laws, and most importantly, trying to make it down the aisle. Will uprooting their lives in the United States pay off or be the biggest mistake ever?

items.title: Grimsburg
items.overview: Flute is suspicious of Summers' new cyborg friend. Martinez joins the Satanic church for the childcare perks.

items.title: Watch What Happens Live
items.episodeTitle: WWHL At Bravo Fan Fest: Eastern Slayboard
items.overview: Watch What Happens Live is an interactive series hosted by Bravo programming executive Andy Cohen, Bravo's Senior Vice President of Original Programming and Development, is best known to viewers as the host of the network's often explosive Watch What Happens reunion specials. Watch What Happens originally debuted as a live online show on www.bravotv.com. Watch What Happens welcomes guests from some of the cable network's most popular series, as well as other entertainment stars, to chat about pop culture and celebrities in the news!

items.title: NBC Nightly News
items.overview: NBC Nightly News is the most-watched evening newscast in America, providing the very latest on the day's top stories and going beyond the headlines to add context and analysis to the most pressing issues of our time, both at home and abroad. We go to the heart of breaking news stories, introduce you to everyday people caught up in extraordinary events, offer in-depth reporting on health and medicine, cover international news as it unfolds and we profile those who inspire us to do better in our popular Making A Difference reports. The award-winning broadcast carries a legacy that spans more than six decades, beginning in 1948 - when NBC started broadcasting television's first-ever regularly scheduled network evening newscast.

items.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
items.episodeTitle: Halloween, Pets in Costumes, and I'm Not Scared, You're Scared
items.overview: ABC's longest-running primetime entertainment show, America's Funniest Home Videos, returns for season 36 this fall with the same mission -- giving families something genuinely funny to enjoy together on Sunday nights."AFV," the longest-running primetime entertainment show in ABC history, returns for season 36 with the same mission - to provide viewers with hysterical moments that fly by at a dizzying pace.

items.title: Face the Nation
items.episodeTitle: 10/25 - A.G. Todd Blanche, Sen. Thom Tillis, Rep. Jason Crow, Rep. Gina Hinojosa
items.overview: Face the Nation is a news interview program which airs every Sunday morning, live from the CBS studio in Washington D.C. It is dedicated to interviewing newsmakers on the latest issues. Guests include government leaders, politicians, and international figures in the news. CBS News… More correspondents engage the guests in a lively roundtable discussion focusing on current topics. The show started on November 7th, 1954, and was originally broadcast on both CBS Television and Radio Networks. After close to two decades, the program was taken off CBS radio.

items.title: American Pickers: Best Of
items.overview: Strange things are happening when Dani sends Mike and Frank to a haunted storage house packed with creepy oddities- like snakes in jars and bizarre sideshow relics, setting the stage for some spine-tingling picks.

items.title: The Real Housewives of Potomac
items.overview: Just up the river from our nation's capital lies a hidden gem—Potomac, Maryland. Its rolling hills, gated mansions, sophisticated prep schools, and exclusive country clubs all serve to keep the area invitation-only. Sprinkled throughout this community are a handful of old-line, wealthy African-American families who have historically broken racial barriers to provide a life of privilege for their children. The Real Housewives of Potomac follows the upscale lives of six intriguing, well-to-do women: Gizelle Bryant, Katie Rost, Karen Huger, Charrisse Jackson-Jordan, Robyn Dixon, and Ashley Darby, all of whom have fought for their places in this society by way of legacy or marriage. In a town where entry is granted only through class, pedigree, and lineage, how far will these ladies go to secure their spot at the top of this prestigious circle?

items.title: Universal Basic Guys
items.overview: Mark and Rhoda team up to beat the DelVecchios in a dance competition. Tammy and Kardgen help with an organ delivery.

items.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
items.overview: THE GREAT HOUDINI – David Pogue looks back at the life and legacy of the legendary man of magic and mystery, Harry Houdini.GHOST SIGNS – Conor Knighton looks at the slowly vanishing history of advertisements painted on the walls of buildings, some dating back to the late 1800s.ELECTION – Matt Gutman reports on Tuesday's critical election in Israel, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political future at stake.BASED ON A TRUE STORY – David Martin has the story of "The Mosquito Bowl," a football game played on the island of Guadalcanal during WWII before the invasion of Okinawa, which is now the subject of a new movie.THE RAVENMASTER – Seth Doane visits the Tower of London and meets the caretakers of the ravens that have become part of the lore.SUNDAY PROFILE: PARKER POSEY – Mo Rocca sits down with Parker Posey ("Best in Show," "The White Lotus" and many more) to talk about her career and new projects.CURTAIN GOING UP… – Faith Salie talks with Missy Mazzoli, composer of a new opera based on the bestselling book Lincoln in the Bardo by George Saunders, and the first woman ever to have a world premiere at the Metropolitan Opera.STEVE HARTMAN –Steve Hartman has the story of two brothers, doctors who give back to the community where they were raised.

items.title: NBC Sunday Night Football
items.episodeTitle: Kansas City Chiefs at Seattle Seahawks
items.overview: Super Bowl LX MVP Kenneth Walker III returns to Seattle alongside three-time Chiefs Super Bowl MVP Patrick Mahomes when undefeated Kansas City (5-0) visits Sam Darnold and the Seahawks (3-3) in the Week 7 edition from Lumen Field in Seattle, Wash.The Chiefs and Seahawks have combined to win three of the past four Super Bowls (LVII, LVIII and LX), with Mahomes or Walker earning MVP honors in each.Former AFC West division rivals from 1977–2001, Kansas City and Seattle meet for the 54th time, with the Chiefs holding a 34-19 advantage in the all-time series. The teams' only previous meeting on SNF came in Week 16 of the 2018 season, when the Seahawks earned a 38-31 home victory to clinch an NFC Wild Card berth. The Chiefs and Seahawks last met on Christmas Eve in 2022, when Kansas City won, 24-10, at Arrowhead Stadium. Mahomes passed for 224 yards and accounted for three touchdowns (two passing and one rushing) in the victory, while Walker, now his teammate, rushed for 107 yards for Seattle. Sunday marks the second meeting between Mahomes and Darnold, who first faced each other in 2020 when Darnold played for the Jets.

items.title: Fashion Forward
items.overview: Fashion Forward is a weekly series that gives you an inside look into the glamorous world of the most stylish stars. Keep up with the latest news, check out what the most influential models are up to on social media, get to know their beauty secrets and learn how to dress like your favourite celebs.

items.title: The Weekend
items.overview: Fresh analysis of the week's biggest events and a rotating crew of major D.C. newsmakers.

items.title: Good Morning America: Weekend Edition
items.overview: GMA Weekend expanded to seven days a week in September 2004, providing up-to-the-minute news, weather and topical features from the familiar set of the weekday program located at the crossroads of the world, Times Square. The show's increased focus on lifestyle, leisure and family-oriented topics are suited for the relaxed pace of the weekend, attracting engaged and loyal GMA viewers as they start their days.Co-anchors Dan Harris and Paula Faris bring great energy and vitality to the morning show. In his 11 years at ABC News, Dan has traveled the globe, reporting from Haiti, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Iraq, Ground Zero, South Korea, Israel and the West Bank. His interests range from international affairs and politics to technology and indie music. Former anchor of ABC's World News Now and America This Morning, Paula delivered unforgettable and colorful accounts from the World Cup. Her popular Real Money reports have shown American families how to save thousands of dollars. As the audience on the weekend continues to grow, GMA is now the #1 morning newscast on Saturdays and regularly beats NBC's Today on Sunday mornings.
